passed: The NIH award identifier agrees across the principal-investigator description and structured funding entries.
The stated research purposes align with the funded critical-care AI infrastructure project.

warnings: The website's current-release snapshot is undated, and actual patient-data collection windows are unspecified, preventing a complete collection-to-release chronology check.
